name: hono-bidder-guest
description: The guest-facing endpoints of one provider of a bidder: its relay, its OIDC issuer, POST /v1/on-network and POST /v1/host-keys, recorded on the ComputeVM status

role.description: Provider this DenoPod answers guests for; names its relay keypair and OIDC signing key in the bidder vault

plc-directory-url.description: PLC directory URL the issuer resolves the bidder's RBAC records through

ingress-proxy-host.description: XRPC relay dispatcher host the provider relay registers with

network-hosts.description: Comma-separated name=address pairs of the market network's service names and the loopback address each answers on, copied from the network value

vault-openbao-server.description: Name of the bidder's OpenBaoServer object; its status gives the vault's address, CA, client certificate and kv mount

vault-openbao-client.description: Client of that OpenBaoServer this DenoPod logs in as (its cert role and policy)

vault-openbao-client-dir.description: Directory holding that client's certificate (tls.crt), key (tls.key) and the vault CA (ca.crt), kept current by the DenoPod's projected credentials; unset, they are read from the files the OpenBaoServer status names

vault-kv-mount-client.description: Client of that OpenBaoServer whose kv mount holds the bidder's keys (the bidder's own client)

vault-kcp-server.description: kcp server holding the OpenBaoServer object, a /clusters/<workspace> URL

vault-kcp-token-file.description: File holding the bearer token for that kcp server, re-read on every call

vault-kcp-ca-cert-file.description: PEM CA bundle that kcp server's certificate chains to

kcp-server.description: kcp server of the bidder's own kcp, where its ComputeVMs live

kcp-token-file.description: File holding this DenoPod's own ServiceAccount token for that kcp, re-read on every call

kcp-ca-file.description: PEM CA bundle of that kcp

handle.description: Bidder handle that owns the ComputeVMs this DenoPod answers for

serve-port.description: Port the local listener binds; 0 reports the bound port

port-file.description: File the bound TCP port is written to once listening

listeners-file.description: File every bound listener (tcp, relay) is reported to as JSON once listening

status-file.description: File the issuer URL, relay ingress and serve port are written to as JSON once ready

denopod-namespace.description: Namespace of the DenoPod this process is the entry of, set by the deno runtime; unset means it was not started by socialweb-computer run bidder
